postContent: Just finished setting up our project subfolder inside the wdd231 repository! Remember to keep all file names lowercase with no spaces.
Testing the mobile layout responsiveness. Checked at 320px width and the layout looks incredibly crisp with zero horizontal scrolling!
Pro tip for week 6: Ensure your page weight stays well under 500kB by compressing images into WebP format before committing.
Integrated the responsive hamburger navigation icon using clean CSS transitions. No heavy libraries or frameworks needed.
Writing the native HTML5 dialog tag for our modular popups. Accessibility out of the box makes keyboard navigation flawless.
Working on the JavaScript fetch utility. Remember to wrap your asynchronous requests in try...catch blocks to handle network drops gracefully.
Using localStorage to remember user preferences like sidebar collapse states. It makes the platform feel like a real application.
Friendly reminder to check color contrast ratios across your custom components. High visibility ensures a positive usability rating.
Spent some time mapping out the relationship between openweathermap data and our social feeds. Can't wait to inject contextual weather widgets!
Adding template literals in JavaScript to render our cards helps organize dynamic templates cleanly without messy string concatenation.
Ensured that all form controls inside the profile page feature explicit labels and required tags to ace the development standards review.
Remember to update the Final Link in your week 1 navigation bar to point directly to this week 6 folder once deployed to GitHub pages.
Using native array methods like filter() to let users filter the social feed by community tag dynamically. Super fast runtime speeds!
Adding functional Open Graph tags into the document head so link previews show the KinSpace logo beautifully when shared.
Completed the resource attributions unstyled subpage. Citations are fully mapped out for all structural icon packs used.
